title: THE LAUNCH · POWER B · WEEK 1
why: Block week 1, day 4: snatch and jump power on a 90-second clock, hill sprints, then the 2:00 swing test. Same card every Thursday.

items.name: Shoulder rolls + arm circles ×10 each way

blocks.title: EVERY 90 S × 8 · SNATCH + JUMP
blocks.meta: 12:00 · 35 lb · rest the remainder of each slot
blocks.format: Each slot: snatch left, snatch right, then tuck jumps. Rest until the next slot starts. Score = slots finished with 30 s or more left.
blocks.workRest: Next Thursday: 8/side + 6 jumps if all 8 slots had rest left today.

items.name: One-arm snatch 35 lb ×6/side
items.detail: punch through at the top, no bang on the forearm

blocks.noteGreen: Green: 8 of 8 slots with rest left (96 snatches).

blocks.title: HILL SPRINTS · 6 × 0.10 MI

items.name: Walk 3.0 mph / 0% until the breath settles (about 1:00)

blocks.text: Short on time? Drop sprints 5 and 6, never the swing test.

blocks.title: 2:00 MAX SWINGS · 60 LB

items.name: Two-hand swing 60 lb · as many as you can in 2:00
items.detail: set the bell down to rest if you need to, clock keeps running

blocks.text: Week 1 benchmark. Write the number down.
